clips.title: The story
paras: This grizzly trophy is the severed head of Tharil'zun, leader of the Blackrock orc Outrunners occupying Stonewatch. Marshal Marris demands it as irrefutable proof that the commander terrorizing the Redridge approaches has been slain.

The Blackrock orcs entrenched within Stonewatch Keep have exerted ruthless pressure on Lakeshire, raiding farms and ambushing travelers along the roads. At the vanguard of these raiding parties were the Blackrock Outrunners, orchestrated by Tharil'zun. Because the garrison in Lakeshire cannot afford to act on rumors or partial victories, Marshal Marris demands concrete proof of the leader's demise. Bringing him Tharil'zun's severed head demonstrates that the coordinated ambushes from the keep have suffered a major blow.
